title: AppArmor mandatory access control confinement
summary: Confines a service binary under an AppArmor enforce-mode profile restricting filesystem access to explicitly permitted paths.

profile_name.description: AppArmor profile identifier loaded into the kernel.

executable_path.description: Absolute path of the confined executable.

allowed_paths.description: Permitted filesystem path scope and permissions for the confined process.

denied_path.description: Out-of-scope sensitive path that the confined process must not access.

requirement.title: AppArmor mandatory access control for {{executable_path}}
requirement.statement: While {{executable_path}} executes on the host, the AppArmor LSM shall confine the process under profile {{profile_name}} in enforce mode permitting only {{allowed_paths}} and denying access to {{denied_path}}.
requirement.rationale: Limits the blast radius of a compromised {{executable_path}} process through kernel-enforced MAC mediation independent of discretionary permissions.

preconditions: AppArmor LSM is active in the kernel.
Profile {{profile_name}} for {{executable_path}} is loaded in enforce mode.
positive_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Execute {{executable_path}} against its authorized {{allowed_paths}} scope and inspect aa-status and /proc/<pid>/attr/current.
positive_case.expected_result: aa-status lists {{profile_name}} in enforce mode, process confinement attribute reports {{profile_name}} (enforce), and authorized operations on {{allowed_paths}} succeed.
positive_case.observable_evidence: aa-status output showing {{profile_name}} in enforce mode and successful workload completion with zero AppArmor DENIED events for {{allowed_paths}}.
positive_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff {{profile_name}} is active in enforce mode for {{executable_path}} and authorized {{allowed_paths}} operations succeed; FAIL if complain/unconfined or authorized access fails.
positive_case.negative_or_failure_case: Paired negative case: accessing {{denied_path}} from {{executable_path}} under {{profile_name}} is denied with EACCES and audited.
positive_case.oracle_source: Linux AppArmor LSM enforce-mode mediation specification and aa-status(8) confinement contract.

preconditions: Profile {{profile_name}} for {{executable_path}} is loaded in enforce mode.
Target {{denied_path}} exists on the host filesystem.
negative_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Attempt to read or write {{denied_path}} from {{executable_path}} (or a confined probe under profile {{profile_name}}).
negative_case.expected_result: AppArmor denies access to {{denied_path}} with EACCES and emits an APPARMOR="DENIED" audit entry naming {{profile_name}}.
negative_case.observable_evidence: Operation fails with EACCES (Permission denied) and kernel or audit log records APPARMOR="DENIED" for {{profile_name}} and {{denied_path}}.
negative_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff access to {{denied_path}} fails with EACCES and logs an AppArmor denial for {{profile_name}}; FAIL if access succeeds or profile is in complain mode.
negative_case.negative_or_failure_case: Fails if {{executable_path}} accesses {{denied_path}} or executes unconfined.
negative_case.oracle_source: Linux AppArmor LSM enforce-mode denial and kernel audit log contract.
